name: Lexicographically earliest sequence of distinct positive integers such that if a digit d in the digit stream (ignoring commas) is even, the previous digit is > d.
comment: Could be summarized as "even digit, previous bigger". A variant of A342042.

mathematica: A382621list[nmax_] := Module[{a, s, invQ, fu = 2}, s[_] := False;
invQ[k_] := invQ[k] = (If[#, s[k] = #]; #) & [MemberQ[Partition[IntegerDigits[k], 2, 1], {i_, j_?EvenQ} /; i <= j]];
NestList[(a = fu; While[s[a] || invQ[a] || invQ[# + First[IntegerDigits[a]]], a++] & [Max[Mod[#, 10], 1]*10]; While[s[fu], fu++]; s[a] = True; a) &, 1, nmax - 1]];
